about: Ryze was the first spirit Lock 1 Distilling Company ever released, launched in June 2017 from the family distillery in Phoenix, across the road from Lock 1 of the Oswego Canal. Cousins Brenden Backus, Stephen Dates and Kevin Dates founded it in 2015 as Oswego County’s first distillery since Prohibition. Backus, the master distiller, made dozens of trial vodkas before settling on this one. The label’s phoenix rising from volcanic ash nods to the village’s name and to how the vodka is filtered.

It is made from New York-grown winter wheat and rye, triple distilled on equipment the cousins fabricated themselves, then filtered through activated carbon and volcanic rock. Lock 1 is a licensed New York farm distillery, so most of its grain must come from within the state. Ryze is bottled at 80 proof, and Lock 1 calls it the most awarded vodka in New York State.

Lock 1 describes a clean vodka with hints of vanilla and citrus, a velvety texture and a gentle, lasting warmth. A Best Tasting Spirits reviewer found apple and banana bread on the nose, rye and a light peppery finish. It has taken silver at the 2020 Denver International Spirits Competition and at the New York State distilled spirits competition.
